name: Kamishiro Minamo
source:
A childhood friend of Natsuki, whom he met when he came to stay with his grandmother after the accident.

A cheerful girl who has never been out of the countryside. Honest to a fault, she's the kind of person who could never do a bad thing willingly. She often finds herself looking after Natsuki.

[From [url=https://atri-mdm.com/en/character/?chara=minamo]official website[/url]]
